quarterly_data.quarter: ACM Research press release: ACM Research Expands Ultra C Tahoe into a Wet Processing (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Ultra C Tahoe platform detail from the product release: adding bench nitrogen (N2) bubbling technology extends the hybrid batch / single-wafer platform to uniform silicon nitride recess etching, polysilicon etching and etch-back, tungsten recess processing and silicon-germanium recess etching, combined with ACM's SAPS, TEBO and SMT technologies and hot IPA drying. ACM states the platform has achieved an average particle count of fewer than 6 particles at 26 nm with surface metal contamination below 1 x 10^9 atoms/cm2, and can reduce sulfuric acid consumption by up to 75%. The Tahoe Recycle monitor wafer reclaim process (film and residue removal, cleaning and drying in one hybrid platform) is running in volume production at customer facilities. CEO David Wang: expanding Tahoe into a multi-process platform 'demonstrates the versatility of our hybrid architecture and its scalability for advanced semiconductor manufacturing.'
